LESSON: MUSICAL

Grade: PP2
Subject: PSYCHOMOTOR AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: PERFORMANCE
Topic 9.1: Musical

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Musical. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.
